description: Search steel products listed for sale on eMetals AI™ (plates, sections, bars, coils, pipes, offcuts and more): name, grade, size, quantity, price, city, and whether the item is EPD-certified green steel with its carbon intensity. Keyword and city accept English or Chinese (e.g. "angle" or 角鋼, "SUS304", "Taichung" or 台中市). A price of 0 means quote on request. Seller identity is not included; each item has a url to its page on emetals.tw, where signed-in members can request a quote. 搜尋平台上架中的鋼材現貨；價格 0 表示需詢價，供應商身分不在回傳內容中，詢價經由各品項的 emetals.tw 網址。

city.description: Optional city or county, e.g. Taichung, 台中市 / 選填，縣市

clearance_only.description: Only surplus, offcut or deadstock items / 只看餘料、邊料、呆料

green_only.description: Only EPD-certified green steel / 只看附 EPD 綠鋼

keyword.description: Product, grade or shape in English or Chinese, e.g. angle, H-beam, SUS304, 角鋼 / 品名、材質或形狀
